parameters.content:
## Post DubBooth voice-dubbing challenge leaderboard updates to Slack

### How it works

This workflow runs either manually or on a 24-hour schedule to publish leaderboard updates for a [Choicer Voicer Free](https://dubbooth.com/ "Choicer Voicer Free") voice-dubbing challenge on DubBooth. It sets the challenge and Slack configuration, retrieves the public leaderboard from DubBooth, formats the top results into a Slack-ready message, and posts it to the configured channel.

### Setup steps

- Configure the challengeId, slackChannelId, and maxRows values in the Configure Challenge node.
- Ensure the DubBooth public leaderboard API endpoint is reachable for the configured challenge ID.
- Connect valid Slack credentials to the Post Leaderboard to Slack node and confirm the bot has permission to post in the target channel.
- Enable the schedule trigger if the leaderboard should be posted automatically every 24 hours.

### Customization

Adjust maxRows to change how many leaderboard entries are posted, update the schedule interval, or modify the code node to change the Slack message format.

### Privacy

This workflow reads only public challenge metadata and scores. Dub recordings stay on each player’s device and are not uploaded by this workflow.

## Trigger and configure

Contains the manual and scheduled entry points, then defines the challenge ID, Slack channel, and maximum leaderboard rows used by the rest of the workflow. These nodes form the left-side startup cluster.

## Fetch and post leaderboard

Retrieves the DubBooth leaderboard, formats it into a Slack message, and posts the update to the configured Slack channel. These nodes form the main processing and output cluster to the right.
